mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% compresses equity valuations by raising the discount rate for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 4.0%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS on 5-day returns is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%), or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL YoY change on 20-day returns is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% and a rise in non-farm payrolls above 200,000 monthly jobs signals an overheating labor market, which triggers a Fed rate hike and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 200000, or the interaction term (UNRATE * PAYEMS) has a Rank IC below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) show year-over-year growth above 5.0% and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1.3 million units, it indicates a strong consumer and housing sector that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS YoY > 5.0% and HOUST > 1300, or the Rank IC for the conjunction of these two conditions is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index base 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing and services, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC for INDPRO on 20-day returns is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.3 million units indicates a robust housing market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1300, or the Rank IC for HOUST on 20-day returns is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE on 5-day returns is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%) and high interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the combination signals a monetary policy tightening cycle that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC for the conjunction of these two conditions is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
